question: What is the name of the Act that governs the rules and service conditions of All-India Services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**All-India Services Act, 1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **All-India Services Act, 1951:** The **All-India Services Act, 1951** was enacted to regulate the recruitment, conditions of service, and disciplinary control of personnel belonging to the **All-India Services**, such as the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS).
 
• The Act empowers the **central government** to make rules and regulations for these services in consultation with the **state governments**. This ensures uniformity in service conditions across the country.
 
• This Act serves as the legal framework for the functioning of the **All-India Services**, which are vital for maintaining administrative cohesion and uniformity in governance across states.
